categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine through timely payment, advancing Maximize timely fine revenue and minimizing administrative and enforcement costs.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative task 12 as evidenced by variant V0004 where payment occurs directly after fine creation.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Resolution of the case through payment after notification and penalty have been applied, contributing to timely fine revenue.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative task 13, evidenced by variants V0003, V0007, and V0008 where payment follows enforcement steps.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Resolution via an administrative appeal process directed to the Prefecture, preserving due-process rights.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative task 14, supported by variant V0006 showing appeal insertion and sending.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Resolution through a judicial appeal brought before a judge, strongly making offender's due-process rights.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative task 19, supported by variant V0005 culminating in an appeal to the judge.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Resolution of the fine via coercive credit collection procedures, helping fine revenue while hurting administrative costs.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative task 20, evidenced by variant V0002 ending with credit collection.
